title: Friend of Florida crash co-pilot says "mayday" audio is "probably the worst thing I've ever heard"
summary: The friend of the co-pilot in the Florida plane crash told Kris Van Cleave that the air traffic control "mayday" audio was "probably the worst thing I've ever heard." An investigation is underway after nine people on board the Learjet were killed as it crashed in West Palm Beach en route to the Bahamas on Sunday.
